cohort: 8,694,669 term vaginal deliveries from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project's National Inpatient Sample from January 2016 to December 2019
finding: Although unsuspected placenta accreta spectrum among patients undergoing term vaginal delivery is rare, it is associated with significant morbidity.
mod_finding: Although rare, unsuspected placenta accreta spectrum diagnosed during term vaginal delivery is associated with significant maternal morbidity.
